checks.check: National outline includes Cabinda exclave
checks.method: Count polygons in Natural Earth admin-1 union; test that Cabinda town (12.20E, 5.55S) falls inside
checks.result: 3 polygon parts; Cabinda inside=True; area 1,244,411 km2

checks.check: Georeference MIREMPET slide 4 (PLANAGEO division map)
checks.method: 36 GCPs from UTM 33S (EPSG:32733) frame ticks, least-squares affine (GDAL/rasterio)
checks.result: RMS 0.75 km, max 1.34 km; pixel size 1.95 km. Positional uncertainty dominated by slide resolution (~2 km/px) and tick reading (+/-1 px).

checks.check: Extract PLANAGEO 'Região Leste (por concluir)' extent
checks.method: Colour threshold of legend green on slide 4, morphological closing, vectorised with GDAL polygonize (rasterio.features.shapes), clipped to Natural Earth outline
checks.result: Leste (pending) = 450,112 km2 (36% of Angola); Norte+Sul (concluded) = 794,299 km2

checks.check: Georeference MIREMPET slide 6 (airborne geophysics domains)
checks.method: 20 GCPs from WGS84 graticule ticks, affine
checks.result: RMS 0.35 km, max 0.53 km

checks.check: Digitise the nine airborne-geophysics domains
checks.method: Vertices read on gridded enlargements of slide 6, transformed with the slide-6 affine, clipped to Angola
checks.result: 9 polygons; together 941,273 km2 = 76% of Angola (domains are not a full partition – NW, coastal basins and SE Kalahari cover are unassigned)

checks.check: Georeference MIREMPET slides 8 and 9 (occurrence maps)
checks.method: 25 and 20 graticule GCPs, affine
checks.result: slide 8 RMS 0.72 km (pixel 2.6 km); slide 9 RMS 0.50 km (pixel 1.7 km)

checks.check: Digitise coloured critical-mineral symbols on slide 9 and test the '>300 points' statement
checks.method: Per-class colour distance to legend swatch, opening, connected components (GDAL-rasterised land mask), centroid; merged clusters counted by area/110 px. Grey classes (Mo+Cu, graphite) not extracted – indistinguishable from roads/text.
checks.result: 190 coloured symbols recovered (Ag:6, Al:5, AuAg:48, CuCoAuPbZn:108, NiCoCuCr:8, PbCuZn:9, V:1, Zn:5). Consistent in order of magnitude with '>300'; exact count needs the IGEO occurrence table.

checks.method: Non-background pixel mask, bounding-box fit to Angola extremes in UTM 33S, polygonised and differenced against Natural Earth outline
checks.result: pixel 2.5 x 2.5 km (anisotropy 1.1%); 0 uncovered patch(es) >1,500 km2 totalling 0 km2

checks.check: Coverage of Digital elevation model (MIREMPET slide 5)
checks.method: Non-background pixel mask, bounding-box fit to Angola extremes in UTM 33S, polygonised and differenced against Natural Earth outline

checks.check: Coverage of Radiometric ternary K–Th–U (MIREMPET slide 5)
checks.method: Non-background pixel mask, bounding-box fit to Angola extremes in UTM 33S, polygonised and differenced against Natural Earth outline
checks.result: pixel 2.8 x 2.7 km (anisotropy 3.2%); 3 uncovered patch(es) >1,500 km2 totalling 30,889 km2 centred near 19.1E 8.3S, 21.2E 17.8S, 16.3E 17.4S

checks.check: Survey-coverage gaps common to the DEM and radiometric products
checks.method: Intersection of the no-data patches of the two independently masked slide-5 images (single-image edge artefacts discarded)
checks.result: 1 consistent gap(s): 27,202 km2 centred 19.2E 8.3S. The magnetic image shows data there, so the magnetic grid may merge a different survey – confirm with flight-line database.
